title: Refresh R437/OQ4 adapter and bind actual rank26/COPY515 physical returns
body:
PR[3690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3690)'s adapter authenticates the older rank34 R437 catalogue. Current R437/OQ4 changes seven ordered records and its digest. This package refreshes that binding and exercises the **actual** rank26 ancestor and COPY515 through nested fixed-role physical CALL/RETURN, then all 63 literal consumers and disposal. **Partial result: the complete GL64 production ordinary/native/router cohort and uniform supplier refinement remain open.**

At source a24f9ff95c12fd0b6792e3f710569237efd72db2, the adapter reconstructs28233 canonical/903456 paid requests and validates all7814016 literal controller events. Exactly five MOVE routes and two IDLE records change. Rank delta is {26:+32,34:-64,42:+32}; rank mass stays1808352. The new ordered digest is cbfea55f5cd0b74a2a0d4292ad0139d2b5bb73127951127698030bc90c73c532; the old digest rejects. Old-data replay is a positive control using the retained compiler, not an independent compiler.

The physical test uses actual IDLE27776 (window6/family209, rank26) and COPY1603 (stage0/position22014, centre475/frame515), not synthetic Templates. At q=3,w=1 it executes real directory production, source-code/program checks, child grants, two CALLs and two protected returns at 2048->832->91. The actual 65-event COPY/read/ERASE interval executes all 63 physical XOR readers, preserving source and private output until disposal. The actual 28416-family topology and 660 staged roles allocate 29097 canonical stream roles, all parked at both cuts; nonparticipating bodies are empty. Parent programs, numerical aliases/heads, canonical streams, erased work, handoff ports and the complete physical parking stack restore. Obsolete rank34, foreign COPY prefix and three malformed physical gates reject. Runtime Word.inspect is disabled for tested operations.

The body is explicitly controlled:46 bits, two 23-bit prefix fibres, stock11 and declared child outputs. It does not execute either complete residual permutation, its full forward/backward sweeps, full GL64 payload, global macroprogram or production wrapper/native/router. The encoded root would require`660*3^4096` bits; the small body is not that packet. BINDING.md gives the conditional source/capsule/consumer implication and keeps the complete cost and visited-cell obligations visible.

RANK26-COST.md derives the actual ancestor's uniform bad-low bound delta26 <=min(1,1664(q-1)/(q(q-2))), below1665/q for q>=1666. Its actual forward plan has6722 commands and both sweeps pay`13444*f` ADDs, versus4936/`9872*f` for rank7. All fallback, preparation, source/route, stock and containing-node costs remain paid. A completed rank26 child includes a whole node; it cannot be priced as just the sampled COPY inside it. No exponent or frontier change is claimed.

Validation: all five registered normal/optimized and actual Git-free CLI commands passed in605.885 seconds; complete exact receipts and source controls. All 132 canonical live dependencies and seven retained inputs are pinned; retained bytes also match their exact origin Git objects. Prior passing baselines are preserved locally; final replay/log/hashes are included. Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-oq4-caller-binding. No selected cold replay, native rebuild, Lean, Docker, independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

PR[3950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950) CI was checked first: run39209275255 passed at364701494bc3d726806a15d4d1d4b547c1e0f9d5. Main20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 and revision6 were refreshed unchanged at checkpoints. Explicit donor assignment refines independent-moment. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950#issuecomment-6261156262. Live overlap includes the physical board2319, the existing1166 handoff and R437 PRs. New3958/3959 endpoint/pooled-owner claims retain physical premises;3959's cross-replica source is outside this unpooled adapter. Coverage is partial.

Credit zxv/PR[3690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3690) for the predecessor adapter and rank34 controlled gate; ai-nanachi/PR[3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647), Ali Romman/PR[1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043), Sagar Thakrar/PR[3700](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3700) and retained R437/native/owner lineage; David Arias/PR[2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753), Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml/PR[2809](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2809)/[2899](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2899)/[2915](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2915)/[3562](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3562), ywz65/PR[2635](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2635) and Nick Petalas/PR[2808](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2808) for caller/backend/parking; alephnan, Adam Gall, Ross Richardson and selected COPY/complete-stream authors. Immediate audits are PR[3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936)/[3950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950). Full notices and Apache-2.0 are retained. New adaptation, tests and writing by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Next: prove/connect the complete production constructors and whole-word primitive/refinement/preparation/visited-cell contracts at this authenticated catalogue, with admitted original-width stock and root/history/precision. Another controlled returned payload would not discharge that join.
